summary: Tested the 3 reported visual/copy bugs plus regressions on the Dra. Brenda Rubio landing page (desktop 1920 + mobile 390) and the backend audience-request API. All 3 bugs are confirmed FIXED: (1) matricula now renders as an integrated gold strip at the bottom of the navy profile card (Manrope sans, 16px, static position, y=743 vs Cobertura block ending at y=702 -> no overlap; verified on mobile too); (2) no drop-cap in Sobre mí — first paragraph is a serif italic pull-quote starting with 'Soy Brenda Mayra Rubio, abogada graduada...', no floated/oversized element found; (3) copy is 100% virtual everywhere — the word 'presencial' does not appear anywhere in the rendered page; Process step 3 says '100% virtual por Zoom', ContactForm subtitle says 'enlace de Zoom para la audiencia virtual', ContactForm sidebar + Footer + Hero bullet all say 'Audiencias 100% virtuales por Zoom'. Regression: all key testids visible, 4 process steps, 2 service cards, 4 correct dropdown options, form submits successfully (form-success + form-new-request reset works), zero console/page errors. Backend: POST /api/audience-requests returns 201 with persisted object and full validation (422 on bad payloads). One real backend bug found: GET /api/audience-requests returns 500.

minor.issue: Returns 500 ResponseValidationError: an existing document in the 'audience_requests' collection has no 'procedure_type' field (legacy/earlier-schema doc), and the strict response_model=List[AudienceRequest] fails validation. Not used by the landing page, but the endpoint is unusable. Fix: make procedure_type Optional with default in the read model or filter/backfill legacy docs.

action_items: Fix GET /api/audience-requests 500 (legacy doc missing procedure_type / strict response_model)
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/audience-requests uses a strict response_model over historical documents; either backfill/migrate legacy docs or relax the read model (Optional fields) to avoid 500s.
The list endpoint is unauthenticated and exposes all submitted personal data (name, email, phone, case description) publicly — consider protecting or removing it.

success_rate.backend: 88% (7/8 pytest tests; only GET list endpoint fails)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ audience requests via API/UI (lawyer_name prefixed TEST_); no delete endpoint exists so they remain in MongoDB 'audience_requests'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Resend email_sent=false with domain-verification error is expected in testing mode. Frontend testids all present and working; the only open issue is GET /api/audience-requests 500 caused by a legacy DB document lacking procedure_type.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/audience-requests: FastAPI serialize_response raises ResponseValidationError for item index 2 ('procedure_type' Field required) — a document stored before the field was added. Reproduce: GET {BASE_URL}/api/audience-requests -> 500 Internal Server Error; backend.err.log shows the missing-field validation error.
